name: opentask
title: OpenTask
description: Manage your self-hosted OpenTask — browse Today and Upcoming, search, complete, and quick-add tasks with natural language.
author: tchsqx582s

commands.name: home
commands.title: My Tasks
commands.subtitle: OpenTask
commands.description: Show your OpenTask tasks: Today, Upcoming, Inbox, and Completed views.

preferences.name: view
preferences.title: Default View
preferences.description: The view shown when the command opens.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Tasks
commands.subtitle: OpenTask
commands.description: Full-text search across your OpenTask tasks and comments.

commands.name: create-task
commands.title: Create Task
commands.subtitle: OpenTask
commands.description: Create an OpenTask task with due date, priority, project, section, and labels.

commands.name: quick-add-task
commands.title: Quick Add Task
commands.subtitle: OpenTask
commands.description: Add a task using OpenTask's natural-language smart input.

commands.name: show-projects
commands.title: Show Projects
commands.subtitle: OpenTask
commands.description: Browse your OpenTask projects and their tasks.

commands.name: show-labels
commands.title: Show Labels
commands.subtitle: OpenTask
commands.description: Browse your OpenTask labels and their tasks.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Menu Bar Tasks
commands.subtitle: OpenTask
commands.description: Show how many tasks are due today in your menu bar, and complete them from there.

preferences.name: hideMenuBarCount
preferences.label: Hide menu bar count
preferences.description: When enabled, the number of tasks due today won't be shown next to the icon.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: OpenTask URL
preferences.description: The URL of your OpenTask instance, e.g. https://tasks.example.com or http://192.168.1.10:7968.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: An OpenTask API token with read/write scope. Create one in OpenTask under Settings → Integrations.
